beats.narration_slice: Storms can rip shelters apart and ruin tools.
beats.visual: Primitive fresco of a violent island storm tearing a branch-and-leaf shelter open while a stone knife and wooden tool are scattered into rain and wind.
beats.purpose: show that storms can destroy shelter and essential primitive tools
beats.visual_fingerprint: wide low-angle shoreline scene; collapsing branch shelter at upper left, wind-driven rain slashing diagonally, broken stone-and-wood tools tumbling across the foreground, dark ochre storm cloud mass
beats.continuity: begin the survival-risk sequence with the environment physically overwhelming built protection

beats.narration_slice: Strong sun and heat can harm your body.
beats.visual: Primitive cave-painting scene of a lone human silhouette crouching beneath a blazing sun pictograph on exposed pale rock, with heat-wave strokes surrounding the body.
beats.purpose: show direct bodily harm from intense sun and heat
beats.visual_fingerprint: medium overhead-feeling composition on an exposed inland rock shelf; single crouched stick figure centered low, enormous terracotta sun disk above, radiating heat marks and sparse dry vegetation, no shelter visible
beats.continuity: shift from storm damage to the opposite weather extreme and focus directly on the body

beats.narration_slice: A bad injury can become dangerous without medical care.
beats.visual: Fresco close-up of an injured leg beside sharp rocks, with a simplified human silhouette gripping the wounded limb and no medical supplies anywhere in the scene.
beats.purpose: show how a serious injury becomes a major survival threat when medical care is unavailable
beats.visual_fingerprint: tight ground-level close-up in a rocky interior clearing; bent leg and wounded shin dominate the frame, jagged stones form a diagonal beneath it, one hand reaches toward the injury, sparse charcoal pain marks
beats.continuity: move from environmental stress to a specific physical injury with a much tighter shot scale

beats.narration_slice: Infection can become serious without treatment.
beats.visual: Primitive diagram-like fresco showing a small wound on a forearm surrounded by expanding dark pigment rings and branching marks that suggest spreading infection.
beats.purpose: show infection spreading outward from an untreated wound
beats.visual_fingerprint: symbolic side-view arm filling the vertical center against bare limestone; tiny wound at wrist, three irregular expanding umber rings and branching charcoal marks moving upward, no landscape elements
beats.continuity: follow the previous injury by revealing a different secondary danger that can develop afterward

beats.narration_slice: Storms can spoil food or cut off fresh water.
beats.visual: Cave-art still of rainwater flooding a primitive food cache while muddy runoff contaminates a small freshwater pool nearby.
beats.purpose: show that storms can destroy stored food and make fresh water unusable
beats.visual_fingerprint: high wide view of a sheltered island hollow; overturned woven-leaf food bundle at right, brown floodwater crossing the frame, small freshwater basin clouded with sediment at left, heavy rain hatches from above
beats.continuity: return from bodily threats to resource failure, using storm consequences different from the destroyed shelter

beats.narration_slice: Rescue may not arrive when you need it.
beats.visual: Minimalist fresco of a tiny stranded human silhouette on a high coastal rock raising both arms toward an empty horizon with no boat or rescuer present.
beats.purpose: show that survival can depend on outside rescue that may not appear
beats.visual_fingerprint: extreme wide side profile of a cliff and empty sea; tiny signaling figure isolated on the far upper right, vast blank parchment-colored horizon occupying most of the frame, a few distant wave glyphs and no vessel
beats.continuity: expand dramatically from damaged local resources to isolation and dependence on help beyond the island

beats.narration_slice: Even in perfect safety, your body would still age.
beats.visual: Primitive symbolic fresco of one human life shown as a single continuous silhouette sequence progressing from upright youth to bent old age beneath an unchanged calm sun.
beats.purpose: show that normal human aging continues even when external dangers are removed
beats.visual_fingerprint: calm flat limestone field with no hazards; four age-stage silhouettes arranged along a gentle upward arc from left to right, ending in a stooped elder with walking stick, soft sun pictograph centered above
beats.continuity: remove storms, injury, scarcity, and isolation from the composition to reveal the unavoidable biological limit

beats.narration_slice: Supplies can extend survival, but they cannot make life endless.
beats.visual: Reflective cave-art composition with abundant primitive food, water vessels, shelter materials, and stone tools surrounding a long ochre path that still ends at the final aged human silhouette.
beats.purpose: summarize that supplies can support a longer survival period without eliminating mortality
beats.visual_fingerprint: balanced frontal tableau in a quiet inland cave-wall setting; supply symbols cluster densely around the lower frame, a long winding ochre path rises through the center, one elderly silhouette stands at its finite endpoint beneath a fading charcoal sun mark
beats.continuity: resolve the aging beat by reintroducing plentiful resources while keeping the finite human lifespan visually explicit
